title: Anthropic connector conformance and Pact contracts

outcomes.statement: The Anthropic adapter implements all five vendor-neutral operations with bounded pagination, exact cost decimals, accurate capability advertisement, and no provider details crossing the connector seam.
outcomes.demo: The rest dispatcher resolves Anthropic; provision, deprovision, syncMembers, syncActivity, and syncCost run against deterministic fixtures; pagination stops at 100 pages; cost values remain exact strings; and the advertised descriptor equals the implemented methods.

outcomes.statement: Every deterministic Anthropic network fixture is protected by a passing Pact consumer contract.
outcomes.demo: The Pact suite covers User Management and Analytics headers, pagination, nullability, classified errors, and rate-limit responses while provider-boundary checks prove names, routes, headers, and response shapes remain under the Anthropic provider directory.

uncertainties.statement: No live Anthropic credentials or invite-canary authorization are available.
uncertainties.resolution: Only deterministic consumer behavior and Pact contracts are in scope. Live-provider acceptance remains exclusively US-054 and cannot be claimed by this story.

uncertainties.statement: Earlier readiness analysis questioned whether the five VendorConnector methods could be conformant-but-unsupported.
uncertainties.resolution: CHG-045 AC1 now explicitly requires provision, deprovision, syncMembers, syncActivity, and syncCost; the descriptor must advertise only methods that are actually implemented.

uncertainties.statement: Provider-shaped data or raw bodies could leak past the adapter while implementing seven endpoint fixture families.
uncertainties.resolution: Anthropic names, routes, headers, and response shapes stay under the provider directory; no raw body crosses the result seam, and Pact plus provider-boundary checks cover every deterministic fixture family.

uncertainties.statement: The adapter consumes both the transport and connector-call journal seams.
uncertainties.resolution: The canonical story is blocked by US-056 and US-057 and must start only after both land; its own bounded implementation remains a single ready work item.
